Hello everyone,
We have a small hotfix patch ready for release, mostly to resolve number of multiplayer stability issues introduced with the previous version.
4.5.4 should now be available via Steam, GOG, and MS Store.
Please find the change log below.
4.5.4 ‘Cygnus’ Hotfix Release Notes
Bugfix
• Fixed federation joiners deleting their custom ship designs.
• Fixed governor and general modifiers staying lost after a colony changed controller and returned.
• Fixed colony modifiers from species traits and cosmic storms growing each day until the next recalculation.
• Fixed market prices and trade statistics counting a month of trades again on every save load.
• Fixed players being logged out of their Paradox account while the game loads.
Stability
• Fixed a Hotjoin OOS where a joining player could pick different random border colors.
• Fixed an OOS where country intel was calculated before other updates finished.
• Fixed a Hotjoin OOS in travel shortcuts caused by out-of-date system status.
• Fixed an OOS where devastation could target a pop that had left its colony.
• Fixed a Hotjoin OOS caused by astral rift owners being recalculated on the joining player only
• Fixed a Hotjoin OOS in modifiers caused by waystation links that differed after a join, mostly after an expulsion.
• Fixed a Hotjoin OOS in ship modifiers caused by ships keeping their old cloak state when added to a fleet.
• Fixed a Hotjoin OOS caused by a joining player getting an arkship with an extra armor part.
• Fixed a Hotjoin OOS caused by a ship aura that was not cleared on the joining player.
• Fixed a Hotjoin OOS caused by cosmic storms changing course on the host only.
• Fixed a Hotjoin OOS caused by several fleet orders losing their state on save or join.
• Fixed a false Hotjoin OOS in the spy network check.
• Fixed a Hotjoin OOS caused by queued fleet actions losing their effect after a load.
• Fixed a Hotjoin OOS where a joining player refused a nomad waystation order.
• Fixed a Hotjoin OOS in colony and Arkship modifiers.
• Fixed an OOS between players of different languages when a stored name uses grammar.
• Fixed an OOS where a delayed event could be dropped on one machine only.
• Fixed an OOS caused by AI empires differing between machines.
• Fixed a Hotjoin OOS where a finished focus reward could finish again on one machine only.
• Fixed a Hotjoin OOS in fleet modifiers (federation unity, navy size) after a join.
• Fixed a Hotjoin OOS where modifiers were recalculated on different days after a join.
• Fixed an OOS where two starbases in one system updated the same list at once.
• Fixed an OOS in the starbase design fallback, which ran on a worker thread.
• Fixed a potential Hotjoin OOS in border ranges when a storm covers a relay.
• Fixed a Hotjoin OOS from storm lists sorted in a different order on the joiner.
• Fixed a potential OOS and crash with Tempest relic storms; their names now match on all machines.
• Fixed a Hotjoin OOS in storm sector blocking after a reroute.
• Fixed an OOS in modded games that destroy a storm field with a script effect.
• Fixed a Hotjoin OOS where a nomad waystation order could be refused after a join.
• Fixed an OOS in wilderness empire biomass counts.
• Fixed an OOS in AI attitude updates.
• Fixed an OOS and crash with enclave and mercenary trade offers.
• Fixed a Hotjoin OOS where crisis empires could pick different enemies.
• Fixed an OOS in galactic market price changes.
• Fixed a Hotjoin OOS in ship bonus updates.
• Fixed an OOS in names stored by event effects.
• Fixed the lobby list not updating when the online connection arrives after the screen is open.
• The lobby list now shows that it is waiting for the online connection.
• Fixed joining a game before the online connection is ready.
• Fixed the game not offering a new login after the online connection was lost.
• Fixed a Hotjoin issue where a country could stay marked as human on the joining player only.
• Fixed a crash when a fleet runs a scripted effect on arrival.
• Fixed a crash from empty name lists, and sped up the lookup of random names.
Let us know if you are still experiencing out of sync related issues.

by PDX-Loke
Hello everyone,
The team has put together one more bugfix patch resolving a number of reported issues.
4.5.3 should now be available via Steam, GOG, and MS Store.
Improvement​
Fixed an issue where a system with four light sources would sometimes appear to have five.
Balance​
Betharian Processing, Exotic Gas Capture, Rare Crystal Extraction, and Volatile Motes Harvesting district specializations are now limited to one per planet.
Virtual Bliss Plaza and Omni-Bliss Nexus now automate Logistic Drone jobs for Gestalt empires.
Hedonists on the Decadent Lifestyle use half as many amenities while the empire has no Consumer Goods deficit.
Tankbound empires now start with an additional Generator District, instead of converting Agriculture or Mining Districts into Generator Districts.
Pop and country ethics attraction are now summed rather than multiplied.
Cybernetic empires can now take Volcanic Climate Mods, a fourth Climate Mods trait that adapts a species to Volcanic Worlds.
Bugfix​
Cyberization should no longer be stuck with -99% situation speed after dealing with spiritualists.
Fixed Synaptic Sub-Processing showing an incorrect bonus.
Fixed Chinese loc for Sapient Specimens.
Sacred Sites no longer appear on Cutholoids hiding as Asteroids.
Waystations upkeep modifiers now correctly apply.
Tankbound Infernal empires no longer start with 3 extra energy districts on their capital.
Improved handling of district specializations when colony owners change or the requirements for the specialization are no longer met:
Coastal Hamlets and Agrarian Villages now change to Aquaculture or Agricultural Focus.
Mixed Industry and Civilian Industry now change to Heavy Industry.
Administrative Hub, Spiritual Enclave, and Sanctuary Enclave now convert between each other.
Subterranean Urbanization now changes to Mineral Extraction.
The Industrial-Trade Quarter, Military Logistics Complex, Popular Research Mall, and Collective Research Complex now correctly convert.
Queued buildings for a branch office or subject holding no longer count towards the building limit of the other holding type.
Attacking armies in combat are moved back to their transport ships if a war ends during combat.
Fixed the scaling of the fleets created for the FOTD separatist civilization.
Fallen Empire buildings now give job automation to Virtual Synthetic empires.
Fixed the "Go to observation post" button not working in the Planet View for Pre-FTL civilization planets.
Downgrading a Deep Space Citadel in multiplayer no longer causes an out-of-sync, and clients can now downgrade their citadels.
Improved handling of district, district specialization, and building assignment during galaxy generation:
Civic and origin starting buildings no longer go missing when the capital is full. Ethic buildings are instead the ones discarded if there is no room.
Civic and origin starting buildings are now placed in their matching district specialization, including on habitats and Arkships.
Pleasure Seekers now start with their extra Civilian Industries and with Holo-Theatres, this should help them cope with starting consumer goods and amenities sues.
Infernal empires with Tree of Life or Here Be Dragons now start with an Agriculture District.
Automated logistic ships will always consider bringing back their loot to the arkships, no matter the distance.
The Exemplary Genetics tradition now correctly reduces the cost of advanced genetic traits.
Fixed broken text at the start of the Terrestrial Telescopes anomaly description.
Occupied subject colonies no longer produce job resources for their overlord.
The job tooltip now shows the resources that the job produces and consumes, not those of the pops that work it.
Resources that a subject's jobs produce for the overlord now scale with job workforce, including automated workforce, instead of with the number of pops working the job.
Fixed an issue causing Necropurge to sometimes fail to create necrophaged pops.
The Monthly Pop Summary now includes unusual sources of pops, such as Necrophaging, events, or other sources.
Corrected sound for the fleet manager policies button.
Fleet actions that cannot be used because of their cost, a cooldown or an ongoing action on the same target now appear disabled in the right-click menu, with the reason in the tooltip.
The cooldown line in action tooltips now shows the trigger_no icon, the same as the other failed conditions.
Fixed missing and double spaces after the trigger_yes and trigger_no icons in some tooltips.
Adjusted the visibility of some precursor digsite to ensure only the player who spawned them can excavate them.
Reworked the logic behind the counters for Scourge infested planets.
The Station Upkeep modifier should now function properly.
The AI will no longer accept Build Waystation Contracts when they are too far above their Station Capacity.

Fixed Habitability being shown as no higher than 125% for species that can reach 175% or 250%. The planet summary, the colonization view, the terraforming panel, the galaxy map and resettlement now all show the real value, along with the correct bonuses from high Habitability.
Fixed the Mutation Authority tooltip claiming a Habitability ceiling of 175% when it grants 125%.
Fixed the Habitability breakdown claiming a species ignores the Habitability ceiling. It now names the Species Adapted Habitability and gives its value.
Fixed the terraforming panel showing one Habitability value on a row and a different value in that row's tooltip.
Fixed the Stellar Ignition description stating the wrong modifier and missing information.
Fixed Mutagenic Habitability species being able to take Hydrocentric without an Aquatic trait.
Fixed the Adapted Habitability Ceiling being ignored on planets that have not been colonized, so the Habitability shown before you settle now matches the colony.
Fixed Dry Climate Mods granting Adapted Habitability on Volcanic Worlds.
Added Volcanic Climate Mods, granting Adapted Habitability on Volcanic Worlds.

Fixed a species that loses a Climate Mods trait getting a random habitability trait. They now gain a random preference from the climate that trait covered, and an Aquatic species always gets Ocean World Preference.
Fixed resettlement counting Auto-Modding in the Habitability they show, which disagreed with the colony view.
Fixed refugees and smuggled pops judging other planets by the Auto-Modding Habitability of the planet they came from.
Fixed fractional Pop Housing Usage and Pop Bonus Workforce values being rounded to whole percentages.
Fixed AI resettlement and auto-migration counting the Auto-Modding of the pops' current planet when judging a destination.
Fixed a typo in a Credits heading.
The Masquerade Faction will no longer demand that Nomads control the Galactic Market.
Re-conquering a rebellion will no longer falsely claim to subjugate them.
Deluge Machine can turn gaia worlds into ocean worlds now.
Thermophile livestock no longer eat food.
Pops can no longer hide in the purge category without being purged to escape having to work in the mines.
Protected Severed Drones and Pre-Sapients now work in Alien Zoos, instead of becoming Civilians or losing their jobs when an Alien Zoo is built.
The Champion's Forge Live! Arkship no longer shows two military Arkship models on top of each other.
Fixed the broken trigger for the Tend the Garden achievement.
The Discover Precursor Insight tooltip now explains that a precursor system with a suitable planet must be inside your borders.
Behemoths now gain Growth when their armies take over a planet.
Colonized Ratling worlds now show the Tomb World colony view, with the city standing on the ground.
The Champion's Forge Live! fleet now stays in the system until its tournament ends.
Champion's Forge Live! tournaments start again after a tournament fails for lack of contestants.
An earlier Champion's Forge Live! tournament can no longer end a newer one early.
The Spawning, Offspring and Genomic Drone tooltips now mention the Alloy upkeep of Thermophile empires.
Nomads now get Society Research from the Ruined Star System and Baol excavation sites in place of terraforming rewards they cannot use.
Fixed two typos in "The Fall of the Shallarians" event.
Added missing localization for the Nomadic Purger preset description.
Nomadic Knights that complete Cosmogenesis no longer receive the Paperclip event.
Fixed an erroneous localization string for Machine Empires in the Genomic Service Outreach tooltip.
Species modification and sub-species integration no longer reset the Auto-Modding progress of the affected pops.
Pops that change strata now keep their auto-modded habitability progress.
Completing a species modification no longer changes the species of every defense army of the old species on a planet that has no pops of that species left.
Military Intel on Arkship colonies now has localization.
AI empires can found Mercenary Enclaves again after a war ends.
UI/UX​
The Deep Space Citadel downgrade window now greys out designs while the downgrade is blocked, for example during combat, and the tooltip explains why.
The job tooltip now shows the effective workforce of the job, and the Alt estimate is per 100 workforce.
District and zone tooltips now show the approximate job production for the overlord.
Job tooltips, the job details panel and the job category tooltips now show the resources that jobs produce for the overlord.
Tooltips now explain when a nomadic empire is blocked from entering other empires where it was expelled through war.

Added the Adapted Habitability game concept, explaining how a species exceeds 100% Habitability and what it gains above that point. Every Trait, Tradition and Authority that grants it now links to the concept.
The Environmental Integration Traditions now show how much they raise the Adapted Habitability Ceiling.
The Habitability breakdown now groups the Species Minimum and Species Adapted Habitability with their sources. Hold ALT to see them.
Set the RGB value for ships to be identical to the map RGB value.
Stability​
Multiplayer out-of-sync checks now compare every colony, fleet, ship and country instead of only the last few, so desyncs are detected sooner and closer to their cause.
Fixed a rare crash that could happen when a subject empire became independent after its overlord was destroyed.
Fixed an out-of-sync error that could happen in multiplayer after a player hot-joined the game.
Fixed an out-of-sync in multiplayer that could occur after a player hot-joined, when starbases, archaeological sites or astral rifts were processed in a different order.
Fixed an out-of-sync related to AI empires.
Fixed an out-of-sync when an AI empire hired a mercenary fleet.
Modding​
Added the keep_automodding parameter to the transfer_pop_amount effect. When set to yes, the moved pops keep their Auto-Modding progress if both pop groups are on the same planet.
Please enjoy!

by Alfray Stryke
Hey folks, unfortunately Eladrin's been off ill this week, so we don’t have a full Dev Diary for this week. However I do have tentative patch notes for the 4.5.2 patch to share with you.
As always, thank you for playing Stellaris and giving us the feedback/bug reports, they help a great deal.
Changes in placeholder italics are still in progress, but aim to be ready for the patch release.
Feature
Nomadic Knights of the Toxic God who tame or slay the Toxic God can now use their Arkships to Detoxify Toxic Terraforming Candidates into habitable worlds.
Improvement
The Job Efficiency from Specialist Training now displays the correct source in the tooltip.
Logistic Ships now show Waystations in the Megastructure Build Menu alongside their dedicated Build Waystation Button for consistency with Arkships.
Renamed the Envoy capacity modifier to be less confusing.
Fire Cult combination jobs now appear for any empire that meets the same conditions as the base job, such as owning a Citadel of Faith or a Galactic Stock Exchange.
Without Shadows of the Shroud, forming and advancing a Covenant now tells you what your Telepaths gain.
Split the defense platforms into their own weapon/defense preference policies. Removed the starbase strike craft weapon preference policy following this as it was no longer needed.
Added the Weapon Preferences (Arkships) policy for nomadic empires. It sets the point defense of all Arkships and the Military Arkship Armaments.
Added the Defense Preferences (Waystations) policy for nomadic empires
The starting Fleet Doctrine, Weapon Preferences and Defense Preferences policies are now randomized, weighted towards the empire's default preferences
Balance
The Conserve approach for Operational Reserves now gives -50% Specialist Job Efficiency, instead of -50% output for Bureaucrats and Researchers.
Armor now costs the same energy and alloy upkeep as a shield of the same tier, down from double.
Maulers are now slightly slower with a base speed of 140 (comparable to frigates) down from 160 (comparable to corvettes).
The Franchising Civic can now ignore Opinion, Trust, and Embassy requirements for proposing Subjugation.
The Pilot Project bonuses now only apply to Cyborg Pops.
The Pilot Project bonuses now give +15% to Elites, +7.5% to Specialists, +10% to Workers and +5% to all.
Fire Cult now grants Job Efficiency to Fire Dancers instead of Unity output, and it scales with the Habitability of each Pop Group rather than the planet average.
Experiment Engineers produce 1 of each research type instead of 2, with their upkeep halved to match. Crime now raises their Job Efficiency rather than scaling research and upkeep in separate steps.
For Gestalt empires, the Covenant with the Cradle of Souls now gives Unity from Psionic Pops, instead of a percentage bonus to Telepath Unity.
Telepaths under the Covenant with the Whisperers in the Void now give 1 of each Research per rank, down from 1.5.
Bugfix
The Large Mega Bombard mutation now has the correct range and fires in combat.
With Archaeo-Engineers, Ancient Suspension Epidermis and Ancient Energized Carapace now add a flat shield bonus instead of multiplying the Space Fauna's total shields.
Ancient Suspension Epidermis, Ancient Energized Carapace and Null Void Epidermis now have stats in line with the other Space Fauna mutations.
Medium and Large Pulse Carapace now have the same armor hardening as the Small size.
Updated waystation collection prioritisation by using a monthly cache for percentage of stockpile used.
Fixed a subject sometimes staying in a war it should have left when declaring independence or changing overlords while fighting multiple wars at once.
Fixed the Hive Fallen Empire installing psionic circuitry into pops made of meat (or rock)
Fixed the "max" parameters of complex_trigger_modifier overwriting the "min" parameter.
Fixed Imperious Architecture not working.
Fleets no longer stay locked in a battle forever when one of their ships drifts out of weapon range.
Starbases and stations that stopped defending themselves during a long battle now recover when the save is loaded.
Fixed Prosperous Unification not giving additional districts for Nomadic empires. Also improved the tooltip for the Nomadic version of the origin.
Bioship living metal armor now mirrors regular living metal armor, including hardening and hull regeneration.
Fixed some tiers of living metal armor being cheaper than intended.
The Crystallinus Diffuser triumph now only boosts non-robotic pops. It now grants +50% Job Efficiency instead of +100% Resources from Jobs.
Individualist Machine and Synthetically Ascended empires now use the Machine rewards for the Crystallinus Diffuser.
Fallen Empire buildings no longer provide automation for Virtual empires.
Nomadic Synthetic Fertility no longer starts with a size 20 Arkship.
Fixed civics and origins trying (and failing) to give traits to Envoys.
The Chamber of Elevation and House of Apotheosis now stop Necrophage Bonus Growth as well as base growth.
Clone Vats and similar no longer have their output diluted by Pops that cannot use them.
Fixed issues with Syamelle's Curse
Crystallization now gives its full bonus on a Massive Crater.
Species traits that produce resources now work for the Precursor stratum.
Fixed the Adaptive Architecture tradition referring to Arkships for Void Dwellers
Fixed Void Dwellers ignoring the thermophile district initialization.
Fixed issues with Psionic Authority tooltips
Hive-minds no longer gain unworkable farmer jobs when choosing to eat titanic life.
Fixed Gateways, Hyper-Relays and the Grand Archive not being buildable by Nomadic empires in some cases.
Fixed tooltip drift with the Dictatorial Alignment Cybernetic Authority.
Fixed Endbringers being allowed to be invited to Federations.
Fixed Endbringers getting the Federation Code tech via Focus rewards
Fixed Democratic Transference only increasing the energy upkeep of districts, not all upkeep.
Fixed the Cybernetic Pilot Projects describing Resource Output when they give Job Efficiency.
A colony that revolts with the backing of another empire now joins that empire, instead of becoming independent.
An empire that backs a revolt is now notified when the colony joins it.
The Planetary Revolt situation now names the empire that the colony will join in its outcome description.
Hive Mind and Machine Intelligence empires that back a revolt now receive the correct message.
Rebels who break away now also claim nearby empty systems.
Species with the Aquatic trait can now use the Wet Climate Mods planet preference from the Cybernetics ascension path.
The Hydrocentric Ascension Perk is now available to Aquatic species that use the Wet Climate Mods planet preference.
Fixed several issues with disabled Nomad Arkships being re-enabled ahead of time.
Nomads that win a war as a secondary participant no longer keep a permanently disabled Arkship.
A recovered Arkship comes back repaired, and the Recover Disabled Nomad Vessel special project can be offered again if the first attempt runs out of time.
Making peace in one war no longer ends occupations that belong to a second, ongoing war against the same empire.
Fixed high Councilor levels inverting the Test Subject losses of the Experimental Testing situation, which added Pops instead of removing them.
Fixed the Fire Cult civic tooltip stating that Fire Oracles and Ember Legions need Habitability below 50% and 20%, when exactly 50% and 20% also qualify.
Fixed a double space in the Fire Cult civic tooltip.
Fixed the Cybernetic Creed tooltip reading "Priest are replaced by Haruspices".
Covenant telepath bonuses now apply as soon as the Covenant is formed, instead of one year later.
Covenant tooltips now show the correct effect for Machine and Gestalt empires.
The Covenant with the Cradle of Souls now shows its Telepath bonus in the Patron panel.
Fixed the Animator of Clay and Pale Mountain minor patrons having misleading tooltips.
The Shroud-Warped leader trait and the Unemployment Benefits modifier no longer scale with the number of traits a species has.
Blocking the Kaleidoscope event from firing for Wilderness Empires in several different circumstances.
Reanimator AI Empires can build Undead Armies again.
Astral Rifts no longer re-open after AI finishes exploring it.
AI empires no longer receive double the rewards from some events.
Espionage operations set to Commence When Ready no longer grant their event rewards twice.
Nomadic Knights of the Toxic God can now settle once they reach the Toxic God system, and keep the Order's Keep and their Knights on the new homeworld.
Nomadic Knights of the Toxic God no longer get stuck when they lose the Order's Keep Arkship. The Quest for the Toxic God now locks while the Arkship is lost, and ends if it is destroyed.
The extra moon of Earth for Nomadic Knights of the Toxic God starting in Sol is now named appropriately.
Fixed issues with the Knights of the Toxic God origin tooltips
Leader traits for gestalt empires are now named correctly
Fixed a leveled technology losing its identity when written to a save.

Fixed starbase weapon preference policies not taking priority when other weapons scored higher. (e.g. starbases preferring to equip plasma weapons instead of swarmer missiles, even with explosive weapon preference)
Fixed the weapon and defense preference policies not appearing until 2200-01-02
Gated the starbase explosive weapon preference policy behind the swarmer missiles tech
Fixed starbase weapon and defense policies not working if the ship auto-designer is turned off
Turning the ship auto-designer back on now refreshes the loadout of existing starbases.
Nomadic empires no longer have the starbase and defense platform preference policies
Fleets no longer keep vanishing and reappearing in the same system when their capital is occupied or held under an enemy FTL inhibitor.
Fleet actions that cannot be used because of their cost, a cooldown or an ongoing action on the same target now appear disabled in the right-click menu, with the reason in the tooltip.
AI
The AI now values the Aquatic trait on species that use the Wet Climate Mods planet preference
UI/UX
Marauder and Fallen Empire Flags are now different to the normal empire flag on Game Setup
The Fire Cult civic tooltip now lists its job replacements under a single Fire Cult Priesthood entry.
The Shroud tab no longer opens itself after you breach the Shroud or start as a Shroudwalker Apprentice.
Tooltips now explain when a nomadic empire is blocked from entering other empires where it was expelled through war.

Renamed the weapon and defense preference policies to Weapon Preferences and Defense Preferences, with the Fleets, Starbases, Defense Platforms, Arkships or Waystations they apply to in parentheses, so they appear together
The Military Policies window opened from the Fleet Manager is now as tall as the Fleet Manager and wider, so the full policy names fit
The Military Policies and Research Policies windows now sort their policies alphabetically, the same as the Policies view
Graphics
Deselect Button now have its own bespoke icon.
The Fleet Manager Red BG now fills up the entire panel.
Stability
Fixed a crash that could occur when loading a save with an unrecognized asteroid belt type.
Fixed a crash on startup caused by a missing or empty language list.
Fixed an issue where a name using a language-specific grammatical form could cause a multiplayer desync.
Fixed a rare case where a war could remain active forever after every real participant on one side was gone.
Fixed a waystation network sometimes keeping a stale reference after a starbase was destroyed under occupation.
Performance
Reduced micro-freezes in late game with nomad AIs
Modding
Shield upkeep scripted variables are renamed to the shared @defense__t_upkeep_* family.
Scripted trigger basic_eligibility_for_separatism_joining_trigger is now separatism_joining_eligibility_trigger, and it takes the rebelling species and the situation as parameters.
Removed the multiply_by_habitability_effect_modifier civic field. Use a triggered_pop_group_modifier on a pop category with a script value instead.
Added define "STATION_BUILD_DISTANCE_MAX" for how many jumps away from a fleet the AI and fleet automation will look to find something for a civilian fleet to do.
Added DESIGNER_STARBASE_WEAPON_PREF_MUL as the starbase and defense platform sibling to DESIGNER_WEAPON_PREF_MUL
Added is_preferred_platform_weapons trigger as a sibling to is_preferred_starbase_weapons

Added set_ai_platform_weapon_preference, set_ai_platform_armor_ratio and set_ai_platform_shields_ratio, with matching clear_ai_platform_weapon_preference, clear_ai_platform_armor_ratio and clear_ai_platform_shields_ratio
Moved the fleet, starbase and defense platform policies to 06_policies_fleets_and_starbases.txt
Added preferred_* country flags that the fleet doctrine and weapon and defense preference policies set when enabled
Added the clear_*_preference_flags, clear_fleet_doctrine_flags and clear_*_preference_overrides scripted effects, and the has_*_doctrine_personality scripted triggers
Renamed defense_platform_policy_effects.txt to fleet_and_starbase_policy_effects.txt
The rest of the team wanted me to include a photo of the co-author of today’s Dev Diary

See you then!

by Eladrin
Hello everyone!
We've updated the 4.5 Open Beta branch with some improvements.

notes.title: Stellaris 4.5 'Cygnus' Open Beta Update 5 Release Notes

items.text: Feature​
Flag emblems are now correctly centered within the Empire's Flag hexagon frame
Improvement​

Starbase, Orbital Ring, and Waystation weapon modules are now weapon-type-specific (lasers, mass drivers, swarmer missiles, particle launchers, psionic torpedoes, scourge missiles, and several strike-craft hangars), each gated by the matching weapon technology and automatically upgrading to your latest tier.

The Starbase Weapon Preference policy now includes Explosive and Strike Craft options, and automated station designs build the weapon modules matching the chosen preference (or follow the fleet's Weapon Preference when set to Match Fleet).
Nomad empires can now benefit from the Composer of Strands, Whisperers in the Void, and End of the Cycle Greatest Patron accords, with Arkship-appropriate rewards.
Adaptive Evolution approach effect will be displayed as an active situation effect instead of just in the tooltip over the approach selection button.
Overall pass to faction and ethic attractions, improving behaviors for small pop groups and concurrent factions
Promoting or suppressing a faction has an impact on its attraction
Factions with the same ethics can be promoted and suppressed separately
Balance​

The Cradle of Souls maximum-intensity aura surge has been reworked. It no longer builds defence platforms; instead every empire with systems in the aura gains Trust and a chance at a Favor, subjects gain Loyalty, Federation members gain Cohesion, and the patron's own colonies gain a crime or deviancy reducing "Cradle's Serenity". The passive starbase fire-rate bonus is removed.

The Instrument and Cradle Chosen psionic leader traits now grant applicable bonuses to Gestalt and Nomad empires instead of slave-workforce, faction, and friendly-territory bonuses they could not use.
All ships and cloned space fauna that have a mineral cost can no longer be built if your Operational Reserves are critical
The Synthetic Awareness luminary trait now grants +15% Job Efficiency for Mechanical and Machine Pops instead of +25% Resources from Jobs.
Each faction now gains attraction in empires holding the secondary ethic it is associated with
Pops no longer favor their current faction when evaluating which faction to join
Pops of another species can now join the Supremacists, at a reduced attraction
A faction losing its potential members is now destroyed after a delay instead of immediately
Progressive, Prosperity and Totalitarian attraction now depends on citizenship rights instead of the Pop's species
The Dimensional Manipulator now grants a fixed number of 5 districts instead of a 33%
Bugfix​
Spell checked localization files
Corrected an error that crept into the Seddom system in Chinese localization (Once again 复合子个体的演示)
Fixed hostility between countries sometimes not updating immediately when it is set in script.
Nomads can now annihilate each other in Machine Uprising wars.

Automated and auto-completed ship designs that lack reactor power now reduce their strike craft alongside weapons, instead of leaving hangars untouched and stripping shields and armor to pay for them.
A component swapped in while an automated design was balancing its power is no longer charged to the power budget twice, so fewer utilities are given up than the shortfall requires.
Fixing Nomadic Grand Archives being destroyed when taking control of a Settled Empire's Starbase.

Fixed the "Distribute Luxury Goods" colony decision not going on cooldown, which let it be re-used repeatedly to refresh its effect. It is now unavailable for the 10-year duration of the Luxuries Distributed modifier.
Fixed metallurgist jobs on the Foundry Arkship zone always paying their extra upkeep in minerals. Empires with Catalytic Processing now correctly pay it in food instead.
Fixed orbital ring weapon modules all reporting the wrong sabotaged component after an enemy Sabotage Starbase operation.
Nomadic Empires can now be reborn as an exiled colony after failing the "End of the Cycle" situation.
The Gravitational Centrifuge that was non-functional on Deep Space Citadels and Orbital Rings can no longer be built on these structures
The Calling of Arms now properly considers ship size when building ships
Defeating the Mutant Hordes before they could take over your colony no longer flag the planets for purging
Fixed a case of Treasure Hunters being blocked if they were in the process of researching Gateway Activation after defeating the voidworms guarding Ness's gate
Forever Cruise Gestalts can now properly upgrade their service districts
Fixed Defender of the Galaxy crisis defeated counter not properly updating when a crisis was vanquished before ambition level 5 was reached.
Adjusted tooltip for unavailable mercenary enclave fleets.
Contracts that time out from no fault of the issuer, now display a clearer notification about it.
The second level of the Scout trait no longer refers to military fleets.
Arkships no longer automatically benefit from the "Foreign Occupation" Planetary Revolt situation modifier when crossing another empire's border.
The Great Pyramid event chain no longer displays a broken tooltip.
Simplified the list of available Tyanki sizes.
The Machine Uprising event will now trigger a Nomadic Machine Empire to spawn for Nomadic Empires.
Restored the missing scrollbar in the starbase Shipyard, Army Hub, Defenses, and Critters lists.
Nomad Vassals now correctly inherit Operational Reserves
Added 5 missing dlc locks to focus tasks
The Eater of Worlds Digest now counts Nomad Arkship colonies in its tally.
The End of the Cycle Creation Accord no longer grants Nomad empires a colonized planet they cannot hold. Nomads now receive a newly materialized Arkship of a type they have researched.
Fixed some planets being impossible to consecrate.
Fixed the adSalivul habitat having a broken string instead of the correct name.
Fix occasional crash when hovering over a leader to view their traits
The Supremacists no longer appear at all in Pacifist empires, instead of existing without being joinable
Persistent factions now survive without members and ignore the potential member thresholds as intended
The Manifesti now accepts only Egalitarian, Pacifist and Xenophile Pops as intended
Factions no longer suffer an attraction penalty for lacking a leader
Existing faction types that do not use their guiding ethic as a Pop filter no longer use it as a growth factor
The ethic growth factor no longer applies while a faction is losing Pops
Negative Pop Ethics Shift Speed modifiers are no longer ignored, and -100% or lower now fully suppresses ethics shift
Fixed Tomb World Environment art.
Adjusted assets for Humanoid City Set.
Arkhships should no longer get deleted by Cetana's storm
Arkships should no longer be targeted instead of the proper planet in the Phaseshift even chain
Fixed an instance of No Category pops stemming from Virtuality and Gia'Zumon interacting strangely
Fixed Hunker Down decision and Storm Manipulation buildings being broken for Storm Chasers

Nomadic Driven Assimilator purge vassals now Assimilate Hive-Minded pops when their Overlord has taken Inevitable Assimilation (or another tradition that unlocks Hive-Minded Assimilation), instead of being forced to purge them.
The bonus Unity, Society Research, and Engineering Research from the Driven Assimilator's Cybernetic Advantage tradition is now gained when a purge vassal carries out the Assimilation.
Galactic Nemesis empires now gain Menace from the "Purge or Assimilate Pops" objective for pops Assimilated by their purge vassals, matching the credit already granted for pops they purge.
Cyber Hive purge vassals now Assimilate pops into the gestalt consciousness as their Overlord would, and receive the associated Cyber Hive Assimilation bonuses.
Purge vassals now handle pops as their Overlord would when the Overlord has the Mechromancy or Galactic Nemesis ascension perks, instead of defaulting to a plain purge.
Fixed size of the Weapon Slots Text Icons
Blocked Sacred Sites from spawning in Sanctuary Systems
Fixed a bug where starbase building queues remain locked after controller flip at the end of a war
Fixed Commercial Pact trade value growing out of control in federations (especially with the automatic Commercial Pact law), where it swung between near-zero and enormous values each month.
Automated science ships once again spread out to survey different systems instead of all converging on the same one.
The Anomaly, Archaeological Site, and Astral Rift views now show the assigned scientist while a science ship carries out that task on automation.
Fixed a case where newly built arkships could get colony events. No you don't have subterraneans living in your soil.
Fixed numerous events, decisions, and buildings silently failing or producing error log spam for Nomad empires.
Fixed a Megacorp becoming Galactic Emperor wiping the Trader jobs from its capital.
Fleets returning from MIA will no longer queue a movement order if they already have other orders.
Suppressing a faction will not also suppress the ones with the same ethic
The Nomadic Gameplay toggle now grays out immediately for multiplayer clients when the host has the Nomads DLC disabled, without needing to reopen the Government & Ethics tab.
Fixed an issue preventing nomadic empires from joining wars
Fixed the auto-pause setting being ignored when the research complete popup opened.
Fixed the Shroud policy offering two options that shared the same key, which could select the wrong option and cause save game errors.
Fixed the terraforming special project resolving against the wrong target instead of the planet being terraformed.
Fixed army build costs not being shown when building armies at a starbase, along with a related crash.
Disabled Arkships no longer appear as colonization sources.
Fixed the species editor button not working if it had already been used on a previously edited empire.
Fixed special projects on Arkship colonies resolving to the wrong planet scope.
The species editor now takes opposing traits into account when working out which planet classes a species can live on.
Fleet settings are now respected by ship upgrade actions and their UI display, and the ship designer no longer opens for ships that have no design template.
Triggered modifier tooltips now show the correct value. The displayed number ignored the modifier's multiplier, though the applied value was always correct.
The Gundersen Research Society now shows its custom start text instead of generic Lost Colony text.
AI​
Fleet composition is now driven by the empire's active fleet doctrine and weapon preference, replacing the previous fixed personality- and civic-based ship ratios.
Crisis and ascension hulls are now favored in fleet composition once unlocked.
UI/UX​
Fixed Contract notification toasts (accepted, completed, abandoned, failed) showing a redundant empire name and a stray line break in their titles.
Fixed the Technologist faction's "AI Allowed" demand description being cut off; it now reads as a complete sentence.
Pop group entries now display every faction of the empire, graying out the ones the group cannot join
New faction tooltips explaining membership, attraction, join conditions and why a Pop Group cannot join
Clarified the ethic and faction membership recap wording
Reorder guiding ethic tooltip to always display the secondary ethic after
Subject agreement terms no longer show empty category headers.
Added the missing War status filter to the galaxy map.
Fixed the Decisions tooltip on the planet view.
The fleet upgrade icon is no longer hidden in fleet summary entries when many fleets are listed.
Volcanic Planets now showcase correct sky assets
Performance​
Daily faction update now evaluates Pop Group pre-triggers, faction potential triggers and join rules once per update
Reduced save game size by no longer storing designed empires that are not needed.
Galactic Community resolutions are now cached rather than recollected during every country modifier update.
Stability​
Fixes an OOS caused by different ordering of focus category tiers.
Fixed a crash that could occur during galaxy generation.
Audio​
Portrait/Paragon remastering - consistent well-balanced volume, all stereo, consistent reverb, minor quality issues fixed.
Events - Volume made consistent and well-balanced.
Archaeology / Special Events - Volume made consistent and well-balanced.
Advisors - Volume made consistent and well-balanced.
Audio credits updated from First Contact through Nomads.
Replaced 16 missing Machine Age portrait and Galactic Paragons voice files and corrected their volume.
Modding​
Added has_aquatic_trait scripted trigger.
Specifying the same event pre-trigger more than once now logs an error
Event pre-trigger failures can now be localized through PRE_TRIGGER_FAIL__ keys
Added the `custom_tooltip_icon` trigger, a `custom_tooltip` variant that always displays pass/fail icons
Added `pop_ethics_filter`, `use_guiding_ethic_as_growth_factor` and `skip_creation_cooldown` to pop faction types
Hidden factions are no longer exempt from POP_FACTION_CREATION_COOLDOWN, use `skip_creation_cooldown` instead
Removed the unused `attraction_custom_title` and `attraction_custom_desc` pop faction type parameters
Added the `POP_FACTION_DESTRUCTION_DELAY` define, removed `POP_CURRENT_FACTION_WEIGHT`
Faction attraction scope cleanup and improvements

set_planet_flag, remove_planet_flag, set_timed_planet_flag and has_planet_flag now also work in colony, carrier, and ship scope (previously planet scope only), operating on the same flag store as the carrier_flag family.
Faction `on_destroy` now has the destroyed faction in the `From` scope
The rollback branch has also been updated to have 4.5 Open Beta Update 4.
Thanks for helping us with the 4.5 release!

by Eladrin
Hello everyone!
We've got a couple more fixes in today's 4.5 Open Beta update:
Bugfix​
Fixed Precursor dig sites (Vultaum, Yuht, First League, Irassian, Cybrex) not appearing when surveying, and the Fear of the Dark origin's hostile empire failing to spawn.
Fixed numerous other events, decisions, and buildings silently failing or producing error log spam for Nomad empires.
The Anomaly, Archaeological Site, and Astral Rift views now show the assigned scientist while a science ship carries out that task on automation.
Fixed Commercial Pact trade value growing out of control in federations (especially with the automatic Commercial Pact law), where it swung between near-zero and enormous values each month.
Fixed a bug where starbase building queues remained locked after a controller flip at the end of a war.
Existing saves with starbase build queues stuck after a controller flip are now repaired on load.
Automated science ships now spread out again, instead of all clustering in the same highest weight system.
Modding

set_planet_flag, remove_planet_flag, set_timed_planet_flag and has_planet_flag now also work in colony, carrier, and ship scope (previously planet scope only), operating on the same flag store as the carrier_flag family.
This should resolve any remaining scoping issues with random events, fixes commercial pacts compounding infinitely, and makes science ships spread out when automating exploration again.
Here's the compiled list from the previous Open Beta releases:
Feature​
Pop groups are no longer divided by Ethics or Factions, instead each pop group will have a given percentage that belongs to each faction or ethic as appropriate. This means that:
THIS IS A BREAKING CHANGE AND WILL NOT PRESERVE SAVE GAME COMPATIBILITY.

Ethics and factions are now shown on the pop group entries in the planetary management UI, with tooltips showing the attraction to ethics and factions. Verbose tooltips are enabled by holding Alt, to show a breakdown of all modifiers for these attractions.
Pops shift ethics and factions more frequently
Pop group faction conversion happens more frequently
Ethic attraction now impacts faction growth
Simplify factions randomization logic

Updated Cyberization policies to account for the changes to pop groups and ethics. The Limited Cybernetic species trait has been removed, instead if the Limited Cyberization policy is in effect, Cybernetic Spiritualist pops do not benefit from Cybernetic Job Efficiency. The Limited Cyborg leader trait still functions as previously. This will also decrease the Approval penalty from regular spiritualist factions from the demand The Flesh is Strong.
Unlocked Knights of the Toxic God for nomads
Added policies to provide better control over the auto-designer for both players and AI:
Added a Fleet Doctrine policy with six doctrines that determine the tactical roles each ship class is designed to fill, affecting automated ship designs and ship-designer auto-complete.
Added Weapon Preference and Defense Preference policies that steer automated ship designs and technology research.
Added Starbase Weapon Preference and Starbase Defense Preference policies so station loadouts can diverge from the fleet.

Federations can now enact laws to grant members free, automatic Commercial Pacts (and, with the Nomads DLC, Wayline Pacts) or Research Agreements. Each law is unavailable to the federation type that already grants the benefit through its perk (Trade League / Research Cooperative).
Trade League federations now provide free, automatic Commercial Pacts between all member empires.
Trade League federations now also provide free, automatic Wayline Pacts between all members. (Requires Nomads)
Cosmogenesis is now available for Nomads
Added a nomad compatible version of Storm Chasers
Storm Attraction is now fully functional for mobile arkships

notes.title: Empires now have more control over their colors

items.text: Added a toggle and selectors in empire creation so you can select your map border and fill colours independently of your flag color.
Ship Color can now be selected independently from flag colors in Empire Creation.
Color swatches in the species creator's flag editor and ship-set selector now show the name of the selected color on hover.
Improvement​
Regular Empires can now cancel accepted contracts after 20 years, with a notification sent to the operator.

The Dyson Swarm "best systems" list will now always show a variety of systems with different resources, so if you have a dozen physics deposits, they won't hide all of your energy systems. All "best systems" finders now show up to 12 systems.
Added new event options to the Forever Cruise situation stage events, allowing players to accept temporary economic penalties to affect the situation's direction.
Balance​
Strike craft and missile defensive modifiers now also affect strike craft and missiles launched from starbases and defense platforms.
The Cybernetic species trait now provides an additional +5% Job Efficiency.
Hive minds which encounter genetic defects during cyberization can now choose a cyberisation policy.
Scientific Arkships now have +5% Deep Scanning Success Chance per Tier
Your Trade Policy now converts the trade value gained from Commercial Pacts and Branch Offices, just like the rest of your trade value (previously this trade was not run through your policy).
The "The Collective Self" technology now grants +1 Envoy.
The "Federation Code" technology now reduces Diplomacy influence upkeep by 25%.
Increased base knights upkeep by .15 alloys and .15 consumer goods
Increased soldier alloy upkeep for arkship military zones by 0.1
Rogue Servitor Forever Cruise Passengers now provide an additional +1% Complex Drone Job Efficiency on top of the base Gestalt bonus.

Consecrate World can now be declared on a curated set of worlds tied to your empire's origin and traits (such as Gaia and relic worlds, and origin-specific worlds like toxic, shrouded, rift, or arc-furnace worlds).

Reworked the Consecrated Worlds reward — consecrating worlds now grants a deterministic, empire-wide bonus to Unity, Amenities, and Spiritualist Ethics Attraction that scales with the number of Consecrated Worlds (+10% / +20% / +40% at 1 / 2 / 3), replacing the previous randomized per-world outcome.
The Paladin Ship now has a dedicated combat computer with Line tactics, giving it proper combat positioning while staying directable in combat, instead of ignoring attackers and holding position.
Scientific Arkships now have +5% Deep Scanning Success Chance per Tier
Your Trade Policy now converts the trade value gained from Commercial Pacts and Branch Offices, just like the rest of your trade value (previously this trade was not run through your policy).
The "The Collective Self" technology now grants +1 Envoy.
The "Federation Code" technology now reduces Diplomacy influence upkeep by 25%.
The Stellar Cannon is now a Tier 3 tech, and requires Wormhole Stabilization and UV Lasers.
Bugfix​
AI and auto-complete ship designs no longer leave weapon or strike craft slots empty after upgrades or power rebalancing.
Fixed auto-generated ships occasionally receiving two sections in a single section slot.
Role-based section selection always resolves a valid section, so screen and point-defense ships receive the correct section.

Harbinger Crystalline Growth Regulators can no longer grow crystals on strike craft that have been launched, and modifiers that increase the armor and/or shields of strike craft no longer render strike craft functionally immune to damage.
Missile and torpedo armor and shields are now correctly applied in combat, so point-defense no longer ignores them.
Fixed Gospel of the Masses additional trade value not applying to your branch offices.
The Branching Out modifier from the Cyberization situation now gives +10% Trader Job Efficiency.

Automated starbase, waystation, and orbital ring designs now fit armor instead of shields in systems or on stations where shields are negated (pulsars, X-ray binaries, turbulent nebulae, and cloaking modules).
Fixed Deep Scan uncovering anomalies and archaeology sites far less often than the intended 7% and 3% chances.
Sero the Younger's Habitable Deep Scan can now uncover resource deposits, anomalies, and archaeology sites instead of only pre-sapients.
The success chance of Sero the Younger's Habitable Deep Scan now correctly diminishes with repeated scans of the same world.
Deep Scan resource caches now correctly scale with the Advanced Xenostudies resolution instead of A Voice for All.
Federation members can now form Commercial Pacts with one another, matching Research Agreements.
Free and automatic Research Agreements between Federation members now correctly benefit from Research Sharing from Agreements modifiers and satisfy faction demands for having Research Agreements.

Fixed federation members losing their existing Commercial Pacts with one another when forming or joining a federation. Members of non-trade federations now keep their pacts, while Trade Leagues replace them with the free federation pact (This only applies to Commercial Pacts between federation members).
Fixed pop and country ethics being permanently and progressively wiped across the galaxy during play.
What makes a man turn neutral? A lust for gold? Power? Or an error in the pop ethics randomizer?
Fixed Protostars not counting towards having energy deposits.
Extended swapping logic for soldiers into knights. All sources of soldier jobs should now be covered
Knight swaps should now work properly for nomads
The Joyous Warrior trait now specifies that its effect can only trigger with the relevant leader leading planetary invasions
If a system's starbase is unoccupied while all its planets are occupied, the system is no longer considered fully occupied.
Fixed the crime events (among others) not firing on arkships
Cryo-Sleepers no longer produce Crime/Deviancy
Clarified the Creativity Exhibition Vault's tooltip for Forever Cruise Rogue Servitors: its production and upkeep effects reach all passengers, not just first-class Bio-Trophies.
Fixed the Machine Uprising resolution notification showing "Unidentified Empire" instead of the names of the empires involved when an uprising was quelled or won.
Synthetic Fertility Nomads are no longer able to build arkships until they have researched droids
Fixed edge cases where Cetana would not properly turn hostile upon war declaration
Added a missing nomad Archaeology notification string
Fixed the Ness treasure system not spawning for non nomad empires
Fixed the Gaia world from Starlit Citadel being impossible to colonize
Fixed a missing icon in the Order's Keep concept tooltip
The Crystalline Bane modifier should now get properly removed
Adjusted the number of ships produced when using the Prethoryn Queen relic
Wilderness and Synthetic Fertility now start with homeworlds of the proper size
Fixed a case of double notification after a machine uprising ends
The Dyson Swarm "best systems" finder will now be based exclusively on raw star resources, and will be unaffected by modifiers like techs or cosmic storms.
The Arc Furnace "best systems" finder will now only show systems that have a Molten World.

notes.title: Fixed numerous issues with Total Wars

items.text: Nomadic Empires will now gain ownership of defeated Arkships and Waystations after Total War status quo victory.
Nomadic Empires will now steal a percentage of the population from planets they destroy during Total Wars.
Arkships defeated by Settled Empires are now destroyed after Total War status quo victory.
Nomadic Empires can now be defeated in Total Wars.

Taking planets in a Total War will now occupy them until the system is fully occupied, then annex them all at once. This prevents a bug where a system without a starbase didn't rebuild it if only some planets were taken.
The leader tooltip is now shown in all places where it should be shown
'Delicious Titans' planet modifier tooltip now correctly says 'Farmers are Converted in Titan Hunters' and doesn't show a broken icon.
savefiles with pending first contact event no longer fail to pick an event sound
Graphical crashfix related to Storm Forecast
Entertainer jobs on Forever Cruise Arkships now correctly come from the Entertainment Hub specialization instead of the Operations Center.
Fix for Nomadic Grand Archives being destroyed when a Settled Empire's system is destroyed.
Fix for Nomadic Grand Archive not being destroyed when a Waystation is lost or downgraded below Tier 2.
Added the bottom border line to the research dropdown in the top Resource Bar
Mandatory Pampering now reduces First Class Passenger Consumer Goods upkeep to 1 (from 1.5) for Rogue Servitors, matching the living standard's description.
Permanent Employment in Forever Cruise now only zombifies the crew, not the passengers
AI nomads no longer accept and ignore Build Waystation contracts when at capacity
The Build Waystation contract is now longer automatically abandoned for players when at double station capacity, only for AI nomads
Fixed several Cosmic Storms anomalies appearing more than once per game when they should be unique.
Removed the habitability requirement for the various Shore Leave internal Forever Cruise contracts.
Fixed ships that are waiting to be killed being counted for ship size-specific caps and special project requirements.
Bio-trophies now give 10 Political Power when playing as Rogue Servitor with the Forever Cruise Origin
AI empires with stealth fleet doctrines now correctly install cloaking devices on auto-designed ships.
Psionic shields are no longer equipped on stealth ships that lack psionic cloaking.
Machine Intelligence and Individualist Machine Forever Cruises with machine passengers now alternate assembly every month.
Cruise crew and passengers no longer incorrectly assigned Grid Amalgamation or Livestock living standards and slavery types.
Species being assimilated no longer incorrectly assigned Grid Amalgamation living standard.
Individualistic Machine Forever Cruise no longer gets an error from placing Robot Assembly Plants at game start.
Species being integrated are no longer eligible for assembly.
The Package Deal living standard in Forever Cruise now grants political power to employed Economy Class Passengers.
Fixed megastructure overclock buttons being unresponsive.
Added missing event sounds to the Forever Cruise situation
Fixed issues when dismantling Beastports on Arkships.
Carrier-computer ships now position themselves using the longer of their weapon or strike craft range, so a carrier with no strike craft no longer charges into close range.
Arkships without equipped weapons no longer charge into melee.
Fixed fleets set to flee when overpowered evaluating their flee condition correctly on an Evasive stance, rather than always evading regardless of the threat.
Fixed Deep Scan uncovering anomalies and archaeology sites far less often than the intended 7% and 3% chances.
Sero the Younger's Habitable Deep Scan can now uncover resource deposits, anomalies, and archaeology sites instead of only pre-sapients.
The success chance of Sero the Younger's Habitable Deep Scan now correctly diminishes with repeated scans of the same world.
Deep Scan resource caches now correctly scale with the Advanced Xenostudies resolution instead of A Voice for All.
Federation members can now form Commercial Pacts with one another, matching Research Agreements.
Free and automatic Research Agreements between Federation members now correctly benefit from Research Sharing from Agreements modifiers and satisfy faction demands for having Research Agreements.

Fixed federation members losing their existing Commercial Pacts with one another when forming or joining a federation. Members of non-trade federations now keep their pacts, while Trade Leagues replace them with the free federation pact (This only applies to Commercial Pacts between federation members).
Fixed issue with district indicators in the planet view
Fixed Stellar Cannon opinion modifier overflow
Fixed the Prospectorium's description incorrectly referring to the Scholarium.
Joining an ongoing war is now considered offensive from the perspective of subject agreement terms, regardless of which side is joined
Federation voting laws now apply when joining and leaving ongoing wars
Fixed manually issued system-wide Harvest orders queueing when there were no valid targets.
Fixed Arkships sometimes giving up on surveying.
Fixed the Declare War button tooltip being incorrect after leaving a federation.
Fixed waylines persisting on the galaxy map after a waystation was removed.
Fixed the Logistic Growth Scaling galaxy setting being truncated to one digit.

Nomadic Purge Vassals are now a special subject type that provide resources to their Overlord through subject taxes. Any remaining pops and resources are handed up to the overlord when the subject finishes its work, instead of being lost when the subject's colony was abandoned. A Purging Complete notification lists the pops and resources handed over to the Overlord when a Purge Vassal finishes its work, including any incidental resources that the planet may have produced during their stay.

Fixed Nomad Overlords not receiving the Unity (Fanatic Purifiers, Determined Exterminators, and Necrophages) or Society Research (Devouring Swarms) generated when their temporary purge subjects purged pops - the reward now goes to the Overlord instead of being lost with the subject.

Nomad purge subjects of assimilating empires (such as Driven Assimilators) now assimilate the pops they can rather than purging them, only exterminating pops that cannot be assimilated. The assimilated pops are handed up to the Overlord when the subject disbands, instead of the subject exterminating everyone or lingering forever as a separate empire.
Nomadic Purge Vassals no longer establish Embassies, and other empires can no longer propose Embassies to them.
Empires now correctly lower their opinion of a Nomad Overlord when its Purge Vassal Necrophages pops of their species
Fixed Necropurge not always creating pops.
The Judicial Execution leader trait now correctly grants bonuses when purging Thermophiles
Fixed the Necrophage Elevation Ceremony failing on Arkships. Elevated pops now adapt to Arkship Habitability, and the Pops Necrophaged notification is now shown, highlighting the Arkship fleet

Nomadic empires attempting to invade the first pre-FTL encounter are now correctly told that they need to survey the planet, not that their pre-ftl interference policy is preventing them from invading the planet.

Fixed a wide-ranging regression that caused many anomalies, events, and origin features to silently stop working - most visibly the classic Precursor dig sites no longer appearing when surveying, and the Fear of the Dark origin's hostile empire failing to spawn.
Empires are no longer allowed to join ongoing wars against their subjects/overlords.
Arkship weapon and reactor specializations now clearly indicate in their tooltip that they add Strategic Resource upkeep, with a link to the Strategic Resources concept explaining what that means.
The game will no longer tell the player to kill their own Behemoth to get rid of the Elder Voidspawn.

4.4.6 Fix: Fixed science ships being lost permanently when set to automatically explore Astral Rifts. Previously an automated science ship would vanish upon reaching a rift and never return, leaving its scientist stranded and cluttering the Outliner with ships stuck Missing In Action.

4.4.6 Fix: Automated ships no longer switch off automation and abandon their current task (constructing a station or megastructure, researching an anomaly or special project, exploring an Astral Rift, or carrying out a special order) when avoiding hostile fleets.

Fixed several minor artifact and anomaly research projects (including the Precursor "Delve into the Secrets" actions, Master's Writings, and numerous other special projects) granting no reward when completed as a Nomad empire.
Fixed an issue where a Nomad waystation disabled by hostile space fauna during a raid could remain disabled after the fauna left the system.
Fixed the "Gather Information" operation sometimes failing to deliver its intelligence report when the target empire no longer existed.
Fixed a script error in the genetic mutation event that could occur for Spiritualist empires.
The "Assault Armies" and "Shipyard" buttons on the Arkship Ship Controls tab are now properly localized in all languages
Fixed the Drums of War event "The Claimant" displaying an incorrect species insult when referring to the rival claimant
Synaptic Lathes with many pop groups on them no longer sometimes stop purging.
Fixed Synaptic Lathes not purging pops. Existing saves with broken lathes will repair at some point over the course of a year.
Nomads can now reactivate and own gateway megastructures
Nomad AI empires now build contract-required Waystations even when over their Starbase Capacity, instead of leaving those contracts unfulfilled.
Scan Debris Contracts now automatically cancel when the target debris decays before it can be scanned, instead of remaining active indefinitely.
The Prosperous Unification origin now displays correct, Arkship-specific effects and flavor text for Nomadic empires, instead of planet-based districts and "Homeworld" terminology
Wars declared with the Nomadic Raid, Plunder, or Wipe Them Out war goals now include the war type in their name, consistent with other war goals
The Anomalous Cube archaeology site now refers to the correct empire (or if communications haven't been established yet, then to "this empire")
AI​
AI empires adopt a fleet doctrine and weapon/defense preferences matching their personality.
Auto-generated ship designs are now fully regenerated when new technology is researched, allowing them to adopt newly unlocked weapons and switch weapon families.
AI empires research weapon technologies matching their preferred weapon type more eagerly.
AI empires research armor or shield technologies in line with their defensive preference.
Sneak-attacker empires are more likely to research cloaking technology.
The AI no longer selects battleship, ember, or Stinger XL sections before it has a usable XL weapon.
The Stinger artillery section is no longer unconditionally preferred over its line section.
AI empires now fit psionic shields when they can afford the zro, instead of always avoiding them.
A shortage of one rare or strategic resource no longer blocks the AI from using weapons and components that rely on other rare resources.
AI empires with stealth fleet doctrines now correctly install cloaking devices on auto-designed ships.
Psionic shields are no longer equipped on stealth ships that lack psionic cloaking.
Fixed AI not handling events if they don't have an idle science ship with a leader.
Fixed AI not declaring war if their naval capacity is too high.

AI empires will no longer fire the Stellar Cannon into the territory of empires they are at peace with (unless recently insulted), and will now prioritize static targets like upgraded starbases and defense platforms when at war.
UI/UX​
Waystations now show the amount of resources collected every month.
Improved Waystation stockpile tooltips.
Overlapping list boxes are now properly centered

Policies are now grouped into collapsible categories (Military, Diplomacy, Economy, Research, Society), with a traffic-light header on each category indicating whether all, some, or none of its policies can currently be changed.
Added a button to collapse or expand all policy categories at once.
Military policies can now be reviewed and changed from the Fleet Manager, and research policies from the Technology view.
Hints nomad players that they can excavate owned dig sites if they have the Frontier Archaeology tradition
Building slots are highlighted when they are selected
Fixed too large hitboxes for overclocking buttons.
In species trait tooltips in empire creation, the portrait requirements are now listed in the correct order.
Fixed the Open Orbital Ring button being hardcoded in planet_view.gui
Notification Icons fix, general centralization
Performance​
macOS builds can now run natively on Apple Silicon as a universal (arm64 + x86_64) binary, no longer requiring Rosetta 2 translation.
Improved mid- and late-game performance by optimizing how pop faction attraction is calculated.
Reduced the CPU and memory overhead of per-fleet order checks, improving performance in large late-game galaxies with many fleets.
Stability​
Fixed a crash that could occur when hovering over certain leader traits.
Fixed a potential crash when generating empire name labels on the galaxy map.
Fixed some more multiplayer out-of-sync issues.
Fixed a crash when quitting the game on macOS.
Modding​
Remove obsolete faction parameters
Added missile armor, shield, and hull point modifiers (flat and percentage variants).
Added triggers pop_ethic_amount, pop_ethic_percentage.
Added effects pop_force_add_ethic, pop_force_remove_ethic, pop_force_transfer_ethic
Fix `pop_force_add_ethic` and `pop_change_ethic` triggers
Remove deprecated triggers `pop_has_ethic` and `pop_group_has_ethic`
Added the can_spawn_random_anomaly, can_spawn_random_archaeological_site, and can_add_random_non_blocker_deposit triggers, and a surveyor parameter to the spawn_random_anomaly effect.
Exposed defines for allowing the AI to ignore the penalties for being over naval cap or over naval cap. The current state of these defines is no change from previous behaviour.
Added pretriggers to ships
Added home_colony and background_colony scopes (similar to home_planet and background_planet, but scope to a colony on any carrier type).
Removed min_navy_for_wars from country types.
Scripted actions support a new automation = {} block with an options sub-block, plus a new fleet-scoped has_automation_flag trigger to gate automation weights.
Scripted action automation = {} blocks now support a parent field that nests an action's row beneath another action in the settings menu.
Added the weapon_and_strike_craft range_components option for ship behaviors.
Expanded the ship_behavior template documentation (move patterns, combat_movement, flee_when_overpowered, allow_emergency_ftl, allow_disengage).
Added the can_spawn_random_anomaly, can_spawn_random_archaeological_site, and can_add_random_non_blocker_deposit triggers, and a surveyor parameter to the spawn_random_anomaly effect.
Exposed defines for allowing the AI to ignore the penalties for being over naval cap or over naval cap. The current state of these defines is no change from previous behaviour.
Updated the documentation for the `create_country` effect.
Added the transfer_resources_to_empire effect, which transfers a country's stockpile of each listed resource
Added the transfer_resources_to_empire effect, which transfers a country's stockpile of each listed resource (optionally a percentage of it) to another country in a single call
create_message now supports a "resources" variable type that prints a country's current stockpile of the listed resources as one string of icon + amount pairs
Resource Regions can now be created and weighted using scripting.
You can now visualize precursors using the debug
The stellaris_test_4.5_rollback branch has also been updated with Open Beta Update 3.
Thanks for helping us with the 4.5 release!
